import unittest
import math
from services.contracts import (
    HealthResponse,
    ScaleRequest,
    ScaleResponse,
    FingeringRequest,
    FingeringResponse,
    PitchDetectionRequest,
    PitchDetectionResponse,
    OmrParseRequest,
    OmrParseResponse,
    GatewayAggregatedHealth
)
from services.music_service.service import MusicTheoryService
from services.tuner_service.service import TunerService
from services.omr_service.service import OmrService
from services.gateway_service.gateway import ApiGateway

class TestMicroservicesAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_contracts_serialization(self):
        scale_req = ScaleRequest(root_note="A", scale_type="minor")
        self.assertEqual(scale_req.to_dict(), {"root_note": "A", "scale_type": "minor"})
        recovered = ScaleRequest.from_dict(scale_req.to_dict())
        self.assertEqual(recovered.root_note, "A")
        self.assertEqual(recovered.scale_type, "minor")

    def test_music_service_scales(self):
        service = MusicTheoryService()
        resp = service.get_scale(ScaleRequest(root_note="C", scale_type="major"))
        self.assertEqual(resp.notes, ["C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "A", "B", "C"])
        self.assertEqual(len(resp.frequencies), 8)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(resp.frequencies[0], 261.63, delta=0.5)

    def test_music_service_fingering(self):
        service = MusicTheoryService()
        open_a = service.get_fingering(FingeringRequest(note="A4"))
        self.assertEqual(open_a.string_name, "A")
        self.assertEqual(open_a.finger_number, 0)

        first_finger_b = service.get_fingering(FingeringRequest(note="B4"))
        self.assertEqual(first_finger_b.string_name, "A")
        self.assertEqual(first_finger_b.finger_number, 1)

        open_d = service.get_fingering(FingeringRequest(note="D4"))
        self.assertEqual(open_d.string_name, "D")
        self.assertEqual(open_d.finger_number, 0)

    def test_tuner_pitch_detection_sine_wave(self):
        service = TunerService()
        sample_rate = 44100
        freq = 440.0
        duration_sec = 0.05
        sample_count = int(sample_rate * duration_sec)
        samples = [
            math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * freq * i / sample_rate)
            for i in range(sample_count)
        ]

        resp = service.detect_pitch(PitchDetectionRequest(samples=samples, sample_rate=sample_rate))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(resp.frequency_hz, 440.0, delta=2.0)
        self.assertEqual(resp.note_name, "A")
        self.assertEqual(resp.octave, 4)
        self.assertTrue(resp.in_tune)
        self.assertLess(abs(resp.cents_off), 5.0)

    def test_omr_service_parsing(self):
        service = OmrService()
        req = OmrParseRequest(image_base64="mock_sheet_base64_payload", detect_slurs=True)
        resp = service.parse_score(req)
        self.assertIsInstance(resp.notes, list)
        self.assertGreater(len(resp.notes), 0)
        self.assertEqual(resp.time_signature, "4/4")
        self.assertGreater(resp.confidence, 0.5)

    def test_gateway_routing_and_aggregated_health(self):
        music_svc = MusicTheoryService()
        tuner_svc = TunerService()
        omr_svc = OmrService()
        gateway = ApiGateway(music_service=music_svc, tuner_service=tuner_svc, omr_service=omr_svc)

        status_code, health = gateway.handle_request("/api/v1/health", "GET", None)
        self.assertEqual(status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(health["gateway_status"], "healthy")
        self.assertIn("music_service", health["services"])
        self.assertIn("tuner_service", health["services"])
        self.assertIn("omr_service", health["services"])

        music_code, music_res = gateway.handle_request("/api/v1/music/scale", "POST", {"root_note": "D", "scale_type": "major"})
        self.assertEqual(music_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(music_res["notes"][0], "D")

        tuner_code, tuner_res = gateway.handle_request("/api/v1/tuner/detect", "POST", {"samples": [0.0] * 512, "sample_rate": 44100})
        self.assertEqual(tuner_code, 200)

        err_code, err_res = gateway.handle_request("/api/v1/unknown", "GET", None)
        self.assertEqual(err_code, 404)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Implement OmrService providing score parsing, slur detection, and measure structuring adhering to OmrParseRequest and OmrParseResponse in services/contracts.py.
